formula: n = n(λ)   (indice dépend de la longueur d'onde)
sketch:
Observe: SVG prism with monochromatic input at wavelength λ;
Canvas 2D overlay shows refracted ray colored per λ using Cauchy
n(λ) = A + B/λ². Student sweeps λ; deviation angle D(λ) = f(n(λ),
prism angle A) HUD; when λ swept across visible range, ray fans out
in a continuous spectrum. Experiment: 3 seeded target
exit-directions; student picks λ (or prism angle) to hit each.
Evaluate: ray hidden; only prism and target markers on screen;
student submits λ blind. Wrinkle: distinguishes Bac dispersion
(quantitative n(λ)) from 2ème spectre-vision (qualitative).
